Technology stocks were firming in recent trading, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding more than 1.4% in value, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising more than 1.3%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Autodesk ( ADSK ) pushed out to a 13% gain at one point during Wednesday trading after the software firm late Tuesday announced the proposed $875 million buyout of PlanGrid, a construction productivity software developer. Autodesk is expecting the acquisition will boost its annual recurring revenue by about $100 million while being slightly dilutive to profitability and cash flow in fiscal 2020.
In other sector news:
(+) Ability ( ABIL ) more than doubled in share price on Wednesday, rising 128%, after it acquired the privately held developer of its Ultimate Interception cellular interception system. Under terms of the proposed transaction, Ability will issue 354,609 shares of its common stock - equal to $1 million, based on Tuesday's closing price of $2.82 a share -along with warrants to buy up to 300,000 additional shares at $3.81 each.
(+) Esterline Technologies ( ESL ) was fractionally higher in recent trading after the defense and aerospace components manufacturer reported non-GAAP Q4 net income of $1.87 per share, beating the Capital IQ consensus by $0.43 per share. Revenue rose to $535.3 million from $528.7 million last year and inching past the Street view expecting $534 million.
